description: QoL #5 — Relative timestamps with absolute-on-hover. Add a PURE relative-time formatter (now-injection, dash sentinel for unparseable/absent) with colocated unit + fast-check tests, a reusable RelativeTime presentational component (relative text + absolute timestamp on hover via native title AND a Cloudscape Popover), and apply it to the fleet Start time column and run-detail created/started/stopped/updated timestamps. Absolute value stays visible on hover and is never altered; unparseable/absent renders the existing '—' with no popover. Independent of the other features.
steps: Create frontend/src/fleet/relativeTime.ts exporting `formatRelativeTime(iso: string | null | undefined, now: number = Date.now()): string` returning 'just now' (elapsed < 60s, and any future/<=0 elapsed to avoid fabrication), '<n>m ago', '<n>h ago', '<n> day ago'/'<n> days ago' (singular at 1), and the dash sentinel '—' for null/undefined/empty/unparseable (Number.isNaN(Date.parse(...))). Mirror the now-injection + '—' conventions in src/fleet/duration.ts. Also export `formatAbsoluteTime(iso: string | null | undefined): string | null` using `new Date(ms).toLocaleString()` (matching formatStartTime), returning null when unparseable.

Create frontend/src/fleet/relativeTime.test.ts with unit boundary cases (just now at 0s and sub-60s, exactly 60s -> 1m, minutes, exactly 3600s -> 1h, hours, exactly 86400s -> '1 day', multiple days, and null/undefined/''/'not-a-date' -> '—') plus a fast-check property mirroring duration.test.ts: for any epoch in a safe range and any now, unparseable input is ALWAYS '—', the bucket is monotone non-decreasing in elapsed time, and output is deterministic for a fixed now.

Create frontend/src/components/RelativeTime.tsx: a presentational component `RelativeTime({ value, now, 'data-testid'? })` that renders formatRelativeTime(value, now) as text wrapped in a Cloudscape Popover (triggerType='text', dismissButton={false}, size='small', content = the absolute formatAbsoluteTime value) AND sets a native `title` attribute to the same absolute string. When formatAbsoluteTime(value) is null (unparseable/absent), render the bare '—' with NO popover and NO title.

Create frontend/src/components/RelativeTime.test.tsx asserting: the relative string renders; the `title` attribute equals the absolute toLocaleString() value; activating the Popover trigger reveals the absolute timestamp text; a null/'not-a-date' value renders '—' and sets no title and no popover trigger. Use @testing-library/react + fireEvent as in LogsPanel.test.tsx.

Edit frontend/src/fleet/FleetView.tsx: in the `startTime` column definition replace `formatStartTime(run.startedAt)` with `<RelativeTime value={run.startedAt ?? null} now={now} />` (the `now` prop is already plumbed into FleetView for determinism). Import RelativeTime from '../components/RelativeTime'. Absent start -> '—' handled by the component.

Edit frontend/src/rundetail/RunDetailView.tsx: surface the run's created/started/stopped/updated timestamps using RelativeTime. If these are not already displayed, add a compact 'Timeline' key/value block (Box variant='awsui-key-label' labels + RelativeTime values) in the RunOrientationStrip or just below it, reading run.createdAt/startedAt/stoppedAt and run.updatedAt. Pass the view's resolved nowMs as the `now` prop so it is deterministic. Do NOT change taskDuration/formatDuration output.

Update frontend/src/fleet/FleetView.test.tsx and frontend/src/rundetail/RunDetailView.test.tsx: adjust/add assertions that the start time and run timestamps render a relative string and expose an absolute `title`; keep existing assertions passing (the start-time cell now shows relative text, not the raw locale string).
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/fleet/relativeTime.test.ts src/components/RelativeTime.test.tsx` passes, including the fast-check property (>=100 iterations).
formatRelativeTime returns '—' for null, undefined, '', and 'not-a-date'; never a fabricated relative value.
RelativeTime shows the relative string with the exact absolute timestamp available on hover (title attribute + Popover) and the absolute value is unchanged.
Fleet Start time column and run-detail created/started/stopped/updated render via RelativeTime; absent timestamps show '—'.
`npx vitest run src/fleet src/rundetail src/components` is green and `npm run build` + `npm run lint` succeed.
